key_insight: IteraSim RAG improves OpenFOAM case generation by combining query expansion, multi-stage retrieval, and specialized agents instead of relying on one flat search and one self-checking model.
engineering_relevance: The system lowers the barrier to setting up CFD cases for non-specialists by helping assemble consistent solver, discretization, boundary-condition, and turbulence-model inputs.
method: LLM expands each request into physics, solver-keyword, and troubleshooting queries
Reciprocal Rank Fusion and MMR re-rank candidates from an HNSW dense vector store
A deterministic router plus Architect/InputWriter/Reviewer agents use a canonical knowledge layer for OpenFOAM setup and repair
evidence_signal: On a 28-case benchmark, the pipeline reached 77.9% mean retrieval coverage, with parameter-modification cases above 90%, and all six reference configurations completed successfully on OpenFOAM v2506.
watch_item: The approach depends on benchmark-specific retrieval quality and a bounded reviewer loop, so robustness may drop when cases fall outside the canonical knowledge layer or available corpus.
paper_title: IteraSim RAG: A Multi-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Back-End for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
